objective: Improve prescription generation and benchmark performance as ground-truth training cases accumulate. Outperforming prior methods is a paper hypothesis, never an inference instruction.
drug_vocabulary: top 128 normalized raw drug names in the initial 8000 training admissions; fixed thereafter; includes unmapped drugs and fluids
inputs: same admission-proxy complaint, acuity and home medicines as v4/v5; no future target fields
ground_truth: observed six-hour prescription names, route, dose value, dose unit, doses per 24 hours; no clinician annotation prerequisite
promotion_score: 0.5 * drug-set micro-F1 + 0.5 * complete-core-order micro-F1 on validation only
evolution: ground-truth error ledger, expanded training-case memory, refitted prescription policy, updated joint order templates, validation promotion and retained previous version
llm: local frozen Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 4bit; plan and select template IDs; structured compiler expands complete order fields
clinical_review: optional secondary evaluation of unobserved clinical attributes; never blocks supervised experiments
published_baselines: Use cited reported scores without reimplementation; protocol-specific panels. Evaluate our method on those protocols before a head-to-head superiority claim.
status: development experiment; not an independently held-out confirmatory test
